Page-lazy-load law applies: only the active page's texts are returned; iterate pages with document.switch. Each entry carries primitiveId/content/x/y/rotation/fontSize/fontName/color/bold/italic.

Read a schematic page's 明细表 (title block): show flag + per-field data. Defaults to the focused page; pass pageUuid for another. Read this first to discover the editable field keys before titleblock.modify.

Modify the focused page's 明细表 (title block): toggle visibility and/or patch fields. titleBlockData carries only items to change ({key:{showTitle?,showValue?,value?}}); unknown keys ignored, untouched items keep current value.
Create a schematic wire polyline.
Check Go daemon and EasyEDA connector availability.
Show a non-blocking toast INSIDE the EasyEDA window — the design flow announces each stage as it passes (完成 X,下一步 Y) so the user can watch progress live.
Zoom to fit all primitives in the focused canvas (适应全部, the `K` shortcut). Works on schematic and PCB. → eda.dmt_EditorControl.zoomToAllPrimitives.
Zoom to fit the currently selected primitives (适应选中). Select first (schematic.select / pcb), then fit. → eda.dmt_EditorControl.zoomToSelectedPrimitives.
Zoom to a rectangular region given by its two X and two unordered Y bounds (canvas units: sch 0.01inch, PCB mil; both y-UP). → eda.dmt_EditorControl.zoomToRegion.

Pan/zoom to a center coordinate and/or scale ratio. Omitted fields keep their current value; scale is a percent (200 = 200%). Sch/symbol units are 0.01inch, PCB/footprint units are mil. → eda.dmt_EditorControl.zoomTo.
